text: Could be a really great game. Waiting times are ridiculously long for some items. Building materials have weird allocations, so nothing gets completed if you have a few on the go at the same time. Best to complete one before moving onto another, even if prompted to increase population count! I enjoy it but will look for a similar game that's not designed around trying to get real money off me.

A good game if you spend the money with in-app purchases. In early levels, the game will give you a lot of bonuses. By the time you reach level 50+, it will actively work against you until you spend money to progress. I've just had a roll back of progress and lost a number of buildings and things in my barn that have just disappeared and customer support have been less than helpful meaning I will have to start again to re-buy those items. Very frustrating. Unlikely to play further!

Whilst this game is fun if you like building your own city. There are a few flaws, such as giving you more and more buildings, but not giving you any land expansion so you have to keep squeezing them in to the same area. It gives you something to do but means that a lot of the extra items, such as large parks or entertainment buildings, just get left because there's nowhere to put them! There's also been no additions to the zoo since I completed it. EXPAND THE LAND PLEASE!

I'm so frustrated with this game now. I have been playing this game for nearly 10 years and rated it 5 stars. It used to be with a variety of mini games which changed frequently. Now? It's been the same borng maps game for YEARS!! The match-3 game is becoming impossible to beat now, which means unless I spend money, I can't beat the level. It looks like people in my team have stopped playing in the regattas and I don't blame. It's not fun anymore!! Rating marked down to 1 star & I can't go lower

I have been playing this game for a few years and enjoyed it. Making progress through a combination of match three game, regatta tasks, farming and building. However; January 2026 they restructured the cash system which now makes progress difficult unless you make large in-app purchases. It used to be fun to play now it's just been ruined by money grabbing by playrix . Don't bother wasting your time or money!

This game was fantastic until the recent (Jan 2026) economy reshuffle update where what used to cost 10 in game 'cash' for a move refill on the match-3 game now costs 900. Bare in mind it costs £1.79 for 1000. So you'd only be buying essentially one set of extra moves on a tough match-3 level. Not to mention how much more expensive everything else in game is now with cash. Its becoming far more pay to play with this update.

Frustrating !!! I have played this game for a couple of years now,I have loved it. Over the last couple of months there have been changes in challenges etc mostly good. BUT now the game is so hard and frustrating. Everything is expensive to buy and the gameplay has become stupidly hard. Easy levels can now take two days! What have you done!?! It seems you want us to spend more and more money....thinking about deleting game now. It's not a pleasure to play anymore ...it's STRESSFUL!!!

Been playing for over a year, used to really enjoy the game but now after recent changes its impossible! Can't progress in any way without spending alot of money, the challenges have become impossible too. Don't waste your money...its a bottomless pit. Un installing, which is a shame as it used to be my favourite game.

would be 5 star but its slow after 20 levels as the side game is incredibly boring and repetitive. the farming and building is great the graphics are good but I can't play the boring game which wants you to spend money to win and isn't even interesting. a lot of the products also take far too long to produce 3 hours for a cheesecake for example. makes one lose interest.

I’ve been playing Township and honestly it’s sad to see what this game has become. It used to be a relaxing farming and town-building game where you could progress just by playing and planning your farm. Now it feels like every update is designed to push you to spend money. Progress is slower, events feel built around microtransactions, and many tasks seem impossible without paying. It feels less like a fun town-building game and more like a constant attempt to get players to buy something.

There is a dead zone at the top of the phone screen where the game won't respond, it makes the match 3 games even harder than they already are. After googling how to fix this issue which appears to be common I haven't been able to fix it. The AI bot in the support chat gave me the same solutions then told me an agent would be with me shortly, 4 days later and I am still waiting.

All of the playthrough demos you may have done on other games... this is nothing like those so it gets 1 star for being misleading. Not only that, but unlike most builders that allow you to skip the final 5 minutes for free, this only allows 30 seconds and then, even at 31 seconds, it's 20 cash which is ridiculous. Don't let this cash cow milk you dry... farming pun intended!

The option of confirm when to spend town money should come back. The game is more driven to get you to spend real money and some stages feel unachievable. Only been playing since Summer 2025 and it's enjoyable, but frustrating when you press something by mistake and the town cash disappears in something you weren't even interested to start with. 100% confirmation option for town money to be reinstated.

Need to be able to convert coins to paper money. Otherwise a good game. As previous comment. Too many components needed to build various enclosures or buildings. Buildings too expensive and take too long to complete. used to enjoy this game but constant start up is very annoying, got a lovely town but considering looking for something similar.

I really enjoyed this game for the first 40 levels but past that, you just can't progress unless you spend money. It's so sad. I even emailed the support team to receive a standard response that the match 3's are beatable. Only if you're prepared to spend several days if you haven't got any power ups left. The extra upgrades that can be achieved by spending ingots or crystals are not sufficient to keep the game going without winning the match 3's. So my advice, don't spend your money.

This game was really cool and I am playing since 3 years now. Township cash was worth more before than now after this new update. The developer became way more greedy. it wasn't cheap before as well but now the prices went up by 20-30 times more expensive for everything which you can buy with township cash but the packages offer about 15 times more only for the same amount. I was spending money on this game but because of this greediness I am seriously thinking to leave this one.

Was fun until extreme green cash cost upgrade. Completed card pack and would have got 10k now, only got 100 and 1,300 in bank after update. Everything costs too much now and probably will end up playing alot less because of it. Also have signed in and still doesn't save progress, each time try just gives option to sign out again. Dev clearly don't care just want cash as not engaging players and concerns. Now deleted not wasting my time anymore using all green / towncash just to progress match 3

Harder and harder- installed 8 years ago and used to enjoy, but now is ridiculous- the amount of money I paid in game(silly me!) to get me nowhere is painful...I build a zoo which was removed over night, but new players have this feature! Every time I review the game I knock down a 🌟... Do something good with this game as is stressful NOT joyful anymore and no real develop anymore in mini-games anymore either. Lack of inspiration? Same boring explorer game!

Really addictive and great game ... for a while. The last update has massively inflated the cost of Tcash for both the Match-3 mini-game and the Ruler of the Mine mini-game, making the experience far less enjoyable. I used to make the occasional purchase but have now uninstalled - a shame as Playrix clearly aren't aligned with their users.

Love the game, has a unique feel with lots of range with candy crush sort of games and competitions as well as time managing resources etc. Major issue though it canes your data, I went out and used my data and within 20mins I had used 1.9GB, also when you open the game and it has new exploration things etc it forces u to do the intro and tutorial, like no I don't want this part let me skip it. Overall good game though.

Since the latest update this game has gone down hill it is virtually impossible to level up on the match 3 game. Before you could buy extra lives for 10tc but now it's 900tc making it impossible to complete when you have 65tc for example. It's the same with hiring the dealer it has just become to expensive with the town cash. The makers of the game are expecting you to spend your money to buy the extra town cash which before the update I was happy to do but now it's just not worth it.

initially very good game!! however after you climb the levels the production time increases massively to the point it becomes pointless to play, and then the cost is an absolute rip off.. really sad as I enjoyed this game but once you reach a higher level it is pointless and too long to wait to enjoy!!!

What was the legendary , fun & enjoyable game I thought it was, has turned into money grabbing greed on behalf of the developers. They are running this game into the ground ! Pretty much everything is taken away from the unlucky gamer, the so called new cash system. I've seen a lot of changes & it's only getting worse sadly. You only have to see other reviews & it's self explanatory. Developers you need to listen to us the customer/player What we are giving in feedback. Stop being Greedy !

It's a good game. Only thing I find annoying is that sometimes you accidentally spend the green cash. For example I was nowhere near winning a level and accidentally clicked add 5 more moves, this was a complete waste. It would be good if there was a second step like asking if you are sure so you don't accidentally buy it.

Been playing for years and it used to be great but recently hard and super hard levels appearing a lot more, my guess is it's intentional so players would spend more with in-game purchases. Also recently, UK players can no longer use the team chat function which massively impacted the experience as it's a team-heavy game, and without the ability to talk to my team, it's just not the same anymore and doesn't sound like the developers have any intentions of finding a solution, it's infuriating!

Several games in one. Maintain and expand the town and while things are being built, made or grown play the other games for rewards. Candy Crush and Adventure type games. Ads show short mini games in the main game with farms, factories etc needing constant attention. I spent a lot on the game over a period, but I enjoyed it so didn't mind, but last year they hiked up the prices for playing aids to a ridiculous level. Two currencies needed. One gained by your play, but the other costs real money.

I saw this game on an ad, and while I hate ads, this one was interactive. Unfortunately, it seems the gameplay on the ad is nothing like the actual game, and it forces me to hold my phone landscape, whereas the ad version didn't. As such, uninstalled. It's a shame, as it's something that I could have played to pass the time in places like waiting rooms or waiting in a car for someone.

*paid to review* Firstly, not the same game as the one in the ads. It does include a 20 second version of it now and then, but still false advertising. Secondly, it's an alright farm simulator; addictive, bright and relaxing. You'll sink hours into it, which is useful considering how often you're needing to wait for tasks. The game tries to be a jack of all trades by fitting many mini-games in, unnecessarily so. A lot is happening, quantity over quality.

Love the farming side, but all the rewards are for the match-3 game. I'd love limited edition decorations or something. And now the match-3 game has a timed element, which is stressful and defeats the whole point of a relaxing farm game. So I don't want to play, and there's no point in doing the reward tasks. Edited to add a star, as I've tried others and this is still the best for farming. But please add decoration rewards!

Can't progress in the game if you don't put actual money in. It used to be fun, and paying few pounds a month was worth it. But now after latest upgrade everything is so unaffordable. You have to beat mach 3 levels to participate in tasks and win prizes, but now it's not possible unless you are willing to spend few pounds a day just to get extra moves as levels get harder and harder. Don't start playing unless you have a lot of money to spare. The game feels more like a cash grab than actual fun

After 7 years of playing I am uninstalling. I loved this game and it slowly lost its sparkle. Variety of side games disappeared but I persisted. This week there has been a major change to all the economics and it's ruined it. I had modest t cash and could use it to progress games, after the conversion I can no longer do so. Eg buying extra moves, after the conversion I cannot do so. It's a shame I enjoyed it but I'm moving on.

WAS great. Now dreadful. I always bought the new pass each time and would also purchase t-cash to help with match 3, so was able to expand relatively quickly. Since the update expansion has ground to a halt and there's no way I'm spending way more money to do the same amount of match 3. So I'm done. And if I'm stuck in the same position for too long and can't expand or clear the match 3 then I'll delete the game and find a new one.

I have been playing this game for 10 years and although in the past you could buy in game stuff, you didnt have to.. and as a result.. I ended up buying stuff! originally this was a 5 star review this new cash system is insulting to us Playrix.. it makes playing the mini game almost impossible without spending a week's wage.. this has been slowly happening over the past few years.. firstly by getting rid of the race of champions.. then by changing the mini game so it is always a match 3.

Used to be a fun little game, but things have again gone in the wrong direction regarding many parts of the game. The latest is the random change with currency value - we now have no idea of the cash value as existing players, a wholy unnecessary change. Map adventures seem to be a struggle to finish for the average pl The last was the market as bundles of upgrade tools are all-in rather than single purchases. There are many more issues aside that, and the game is seemingly driving players away.

It started good, you build/ decorate a town and produce goods for town, train and plane orders. Unfortunately, as soon as you start to build and are invested, everything becomes about money or the side game match 3. The time it takes to do anything is massive unless you buy township money to make it quicker. If you have a problem and try to reach customer service, they give you bot responses, if you keep trying they ban your account from accessing customer service, its appalling.

This game use to be fun and you always had the option to buy in app purchases which I didn’t mind spending on now and again, but since the upgrade it's become impossible to move forward without spending money, which by the way has now increase to a ridiculous amount, you're spending 3 times the amount you did before. It's not worth it anymore. It feels more like gambling at a loss rather than just a phone game.

after a recent update to make the towncash system 'fairer', not so. Everything is geared to get you to buy boosters and/or towncash. Towncash is harder to get but everything to buy with it has increased a lot. The match 3 games were fun at 1st but now they're rigged with limited moves and impossible goals (to get you to buy boosters). Making items to fill orders takes ages, constantly running out of storage spaces in the barn, this isn't fun, it's frustrating. Not wasting more money, uninstalled

The game app was fine for some time. Latest update change the level of in game cash that is needed by x25-40. This makes is impossible to play, the cost of buying in game cash has gone up so you get less for how much you pay. It was fine while it lasted. Time to delete the game. All support tickets online show gaslighting in their responses and lose of user engagement. Do not download the app.

I've had this game for a couple of weeks now. At first, it seemed fun and I enjoyed building my town and keeping orders met, but Jeez, it gets boring quickly. Everything takes an absolute eternity and what's the point of adding the airport? I can't supply the helicopter with enough stuff in time, let alone supply the town AND train! The buildings take forever to build, produce takes forever and EVERYTHING costs real money. Plus the minigames are rigged. Uninstalling.

The recent money update ruined the game and feels even more like a money grab game from the devs. I was able to get extra moves for 10 notes per level it now costs 900, 1800 for a 2nd time. My money barely changed unlike others - from being able to pay for 2 extra lives (between 10-20) and only got taken up to 275. So I lost massive value in this update and making it even harder to progress when stuck, bearing in mind I can no longer afford even 1 extra go.

I absolutely loved this game, have been playing for over a year, love the team play element and the other parts of the game. not impressed by the recent updates tho, the green bucks value has increased so much devaluing them, very annoying when as ive spent actual money on them, the new power ups in the match game are useless, the tasks used be much better, now you have to play sooo many match levels to gain bonuses its become boring, such a shame as it was so good before.

I have been playing this game for years now. but today, for some reason my township cash suddenly disappeared, which is a lot, without me using it. I followed instructions and restarted my phone but it didn't fix the issue. no contact numbers and now way to contact customer service. there is only a chatbot that doesn't really help solve the problem.

This was a decent game until the latest Jan update where they have increased the costs to buy items in game by a stupid amount, mini games which are extremely difficult on the hard/super hard levels. Continues would cost $10 which is attainable in game without paying actual money for in game cash. You could win some normal games and build up boosters to go on a run, however a continue is now $900 and a low level player has no way of obtaining that much cash. Dev cash grab, disgusting.

The new update is awful. It just shows thay playrix are fueled by greed. 900 town cash to continue a match 3 level now when it used to be 10. some levels usually 'easy' ones are impossible to pass without using t cash. all mini games and require you to play match 3. isnt this supposed to be a farming and town building game? yet to progress and win decorations etc you have to play match 3, a crazy amount of it too if you want to succeed and win. YOU RUINED THE GAME.

The game started to be all about money for Playrix. It's all about match 3 game now. to progress must of challenges and events you need to play match 3. There are some very difficult level which is impossible to pass without paying towcash and after recent economy update one extra attempt at a game is basically £2... a joke. it was expensive already but now it's really a disgrace what they have done. Less fun, more business. Do not waste your time on downloading this game.

Infuriating. I've played this game for 8 years every day, I know that sounds excessive but I have enjoyed it that much and then recently they have changed everything and make it impossible to progress unless you spend ALOT of money. So if you're thinking of starting it, don't bother, its all about greed and making money. There's literally no point to it anymore.

Great game if you're rich... Since last update (did 22/01/26) the town cash side has become RIDICULOUS! You used to be able to buy 50 cash for £1.79. Now that gets you 1000 cash. Sounds good? NO. To be able to buy an extra ⛏️ for the mine used to cost 1 now it's 125. To get extra moves at the end of the match 3 style mini game was 10 cash. Now it is 900! These are just an example. The 50 cash in app purchase used to be a cheap help without spending a fortune of real money. I'm uninstalling 😡

The game used to be great with a variety of mini games within the main town building game. Over the past year, it's become more expensive and less fun to play with every upgrade. Forums are awash with players venting their frustration. The mini adventure game that involves removing numerous obstacles to progress, is now tedious and boring: you get seconds of play after hours of building energy. Jan 2026: Unbelievably, it just got a lot worse, with a greedy 'economy' update. Very sad.

i've been playing township for nearly a year now and have loved playing it . yes I've had to spend little money to get places which is normal on games . but since the new update about week ago , I am very disappointed because it has become a lot harder to achieve any goal ,wanting you to spent a lot more money , double or even triple the amount from before. so i'm waiting for my pass to run out and then I'll be deleting the game to found another game that doesn't rip you for money. very upset

Used to be great, would buy a little pack as it wasn't much and you got use out of it, for 1.69 you could get 50, so that's 5 plus 5 moves on the match 3 game, why is it you can now buy 1000 and that same plus 5 moves is 900??? That is a 90× uncharge on the game price so you only get 1 over 5 that you got previously. Another example is speeding up trains used to be 9 in game cash, it is now over 200, one was 216, x24 more.Do better.

I played this game for about 2 years and it's great and helps pass the time etc. however like your see from various other people and if you search your find more details. But the biggest update recently has basically killed the game for alot of people and it's just about greed from the developers. please look at how much you have annoyed all of the dedicated players and think about changing this as your just loose money than make more revenue.

It's changed, and not for the better. The recent update has changed the monetary value, and everything has become more expensive. I used to spend a fair bit on levels I'd get stuck at in order to progress faster, but now I won't be. The game is slowly being killed by the newish owners, who clearly have no interest in providing a fun game - just a greedy update which is going to make people uninstall it (clearly, it's making people leave, if you look at all the reviews) TIME WILL TELL....

I love this game, I've been playing everyday for over a year but its clear they keep making changes to make the game less and less enjoyable and focus on extracting as much money as possible. The new economy update is a last straw things are way more expensive now and on top of that they took away the setting to prevent accidental purchases. The greed is too much!

Brilliant game has been ruined! I have played this game nearly every single day for 7 years, spending real life money on it regularly but since last week when we got a "Economy upgrade" they have completely ruined the game and made me want to stop playing. The in cash game is now ridiculously disproportionate. They have made it impossible to play Match 3 without spending money which in turn means playing the whole game is pointless. Very sad.

This game is a con! It's really tetris disguised as a "base building game" The tetris part is impossible. Even to get to level 80 was a grind. It pushes mico transactions so you can get past the level you've been stuck on for 2 hours. and after getting past that level, you're then stuck on the next level. The base building part seems completely separate from this "mini" game.. aka tetris. the monthly pass is mostly aimed towards "helping" with the tetris game.. but it doesn't make it easier.

This game used to be good though things progressively worse and worse with the final nail being the economy update which has halted all progression unless a lot of real money is paid. It's a real shame as I have been playing the same game with all the current progression over 3 devices which is many years of play. I'm very disappointed the developer/publisher have decided to be as money hoarding as every other company out there. Things need to change.

Have played this game for over 2 years, the advert isn't anything like the game, so basically false advertising. The developers made various changes lately, art good. The bad part is that they've enlarged some of the icn sizes that it has affected game play, ie when getting goods or loading carriages, you have to wait to make the next move.

cashgrab - the latest update was meant to fairer play. all they've done it made it more expensive to play the game. More expensive to buy extra turns and get cash. this is now a pay to play if you want to progress. it always was, but its now priced out most people enjoying the game. your cash holds less value than before. it was 10tc to get an extra turn. its now 900tc. 50tc was £1.79 and got you 5 extra turns. now its £1.79 for 1000tc, that gets you 1 turn. time to uninstall.

its an addictive game, lovely graphics, but as with all of your games, as you level up, things get harder, not easier. Things cost more, it's harder to upgrade, the stuff you need doesn't come in on trains that often, the trains take longer. It's frustrating, not challenging. You want people to spend actual cash on this, that's obvious. However, it's making this player want to spend less, not more.

I love this game. I have been playing for 2 years and find it really relaxes me. However, I really dislike the new tool exchange. It's hard enougb collecting materials for buildings without having to swap the materials you do have for tools. I now have 3 buildings I can't complete and my barn is getting full too easy as a result. It's unfair to expect us to pay real money to empty the piggy bank too.

A fun little game, however ruined by the heavy push on in-app purchases. You build your town, develop it, but from the start it teaches you to 'speed up' by using the in-game money. Then you're left to play it, only problem is that with each new level there's more incentives to try encourage in-app purchases. Earning in-game money is possible but slow and laborious and you don't make much each time. I became so bored of the push on in-app purchasing that I deleted it after level 20.

Used to like the game, stopped playing a long time ago, mostly due to the false advertising of the game, claiming to be one type of game, then ending up to be something else. It's false advertising! You have done the same with fishdom, gardenscapes and homescapes. It boggles my mind that you're advertising it this way, when they are perfectly good games, why advertise them as a different game than what it actually is? Maybe when you start advertising the game, as the actual game, I'll play again

This game is okay and it is quite addictive but i have some issues with it, issue one: it won't let me use my own profile picture (which is a picture of myself) on the game when i log in to facebook, issue two: what is the aim of this game because all i am doing is putting buildings down in different places unloading or loading up and train and running out of space and issue three: it kind of gets boring after a while.

I have installed this game a few days ago and it is quite addictive. The only thing I'm finding is things take too long to build. Also, it's very difficult to upgrade community buildings or even something simple like the barn. The game is quite pleasant to the eye but I'm getting the impression that if you don't spend real money to buy their currencies you soon will be frustrated. It requires so many orders shipped and trains sent with cargo, it's annoying!

If you're a maths genius, then this game is fine. I find it incredibly difficult to figure out what I need to farm in order to meet all the orders; standard orders, train orders, helicopter orders, zoo orders... no doubt more that I've not reached yet. My favourite thing in the game was helping my friends, but for some reason yesterday they made it really difficult to find what your friends need help with. Please can that be changed back?

Advertisement is very misleading. I used to play this game daily but they have changed it so much I had to give up on it. It used to be a fun and relaxing game of building a township, doing different daily tasks and challenges, as well as match 3 games. Now they have removed some beloved features like the zoo for some, it's harder to obtain materials to build things, and made it mostly a constant match 3 game that doesn't even give much coins to purchase factories, buildings, and decorations.

I enjoyed playing for a while, but it quickly became obvious that I was never going to be able to get the required building materials without paying too much money for them After about a week, I had 7 buildings I couldn't construct and all my quests depending on them, so after yet another useless train delivery I did the only rational action ... Uninstall It's fine for you if you're really rich, but if that's the case you've probably got better ways to spend your time! LOL

I like it, but I do agree with some other comments, it takes an age to build community buildings to increase town population, don't get me started on the zoo. Some enclosures require over 100 materials and that takes up space in your barn. I think they're being a bit unrealistic. Also the trains never bring you the items you need only what you've most of in the barn. I have played this game for 2 years and I'm only on level 66, that said, I do like it.

Update: uninstalled the game now. Absolutely not worth your time, it was fun for a bit and I didn't mind spending money even but not anymore. First of all, the game is nothing like the ad. Secondly, impossible to develop your town after certain level without spending money because the the trains keep bringing stuff you don't need to force you to spend money. As I've not been able to expand the town for at least 3 levels to build new factories etc I eventually lost interest.

How deadly-dull and what a rip-off! So I played a trial of the game, it was good so I went ahead and downloaded the game to play. Sadly when I came to play after download then I was met with some rather dull, 'plant some wheat.' I don't think so! Slow, patronising, so you guessed it, I un-installed the game! I'm not into long, painfully slow task completions! Great if you 6 year's of age.... Soz guys too much.

Agree entirely with David Davies re mini games. Far too often "candy crush" type game. I don't want /expect easy but expanding isn't quick enough relative to buildings + unable to zoom out is why 95% of players don't lay out and just group buildings. (This is what stifled my creativity until viewing the area by "the orders" a little helpful). Although I've lowered my rating I'm still playing regularly.

Had to edit my review. After a while, it becomes pretty evident that this game is completely rigged. No skill can get past the impossible match 3 levels that it throws at you over and over and over again. If you're looking for a game to throw money at, this game will suck it straight out of you. Luckily I only spent some saved up playstore credits. the difference in progression when paying compared to not paying is insane. AVOID.

False Advertisement. It's a Farmville knock off, not a game where you match the tools to the job. I didn't even see that once and I got to roughly level 18 before getting really bored and uninatalling the game. If you're looking for a farming style game to kill time (personally those games bore me), it's not that bad but if you actually wanted to play the matching game then don't bother with it!

When I first started playing over five years ago, I gave a Four Star rating (would have been 5 but the were quite a few glitches at the time). It was fun to play with a variety of in-games. In the past year, the game we knew and loved has changed. The Room Renovations and Zoo, which many of us worked hard and spent cash to complete, swept away. Those behind the game are only interested in extracting as much cash from players as possible, and it is boring and no longer fun to play :(

Another pay-to-play game.... yep sure you can get along without spending money but it is soooooo slow..... I have waited for 4 days for materials to arrive to complete a building.... but I can of course buy the money to complete it straight away in the Play store..... also with some quests (e.g. Airport) you have to produce the goods before the plane leaves.... of course often the only way to get goods fast enough is to spend more cash!

I like the game and find the regatta and team feed helpful... but a few suggestions... as someone has mentioned, it takes too long to expand your ground or population. Maybe make train trips shorter. Also, some of the mini games are too hard. The explosive puzzle game use to be fun but is way too hard now and up too often. This puts me off opening any chests and is annoying when all gifts and prizes are related to that game.

I love the game but hate how slow the expansions are! Just this morning I noticed an error, I won 2 saws from chests in the mine and thought ''great just what I need for an expansion'', only to find the 2 saws have not even been added, I still only have one which was there before! What a rip off! The game is mean with cash pay outs so that you have to purchase packages with your debit card also it's impossible to fill plane orders unless you purchase the market help!

Downloaded Township after seeing the Ad. This game is nothing like the Ad. It takes too long to acquire buildings, crops take ages to grow. The factory processing is another lengthy wait. The trains & ships take forever to return with much needed supplies. The expansion process is pointless for the small area you are allowed. Most of the time, you're waiting around for things to happen. Don't waste time downloading this game unless you're a zombie with copious amounts of money to waste!!

This game doesn't know what it wants to be. A management sim or a puzzle game? The games BIGGEST flaw is the growing of wheat, corn, carrots etc or the boxing of products etc. This is a mobile game, nobody is going to wait long periods of time.
